question: Should ClickClack remember each sidebar section's expanded state per workspace in browser localStorage?
rationale: Correctness and proof establish that the implementation works, but they cannot determine whether persistent disclosure state is the intended long-term navigation contract.

options.title: Sponsor persistent disclosures
options.body: Accept independent disclosures and remember the three section states separately for each workspace in the current browser profile.

options.title: Narrow to session-only state
options.body: Keep the disclosure controls but reset every section to expanded on reload or workspace navigation.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Retain the current static sidebar sections and close the proposal despite its technically sound implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor persistent disclosures
recommendation.body: Accept independent disclosures and remember the three section states separately for each workspace in the current browser profile.

likelyOwner.reason: The current sidebar and surrounding navigation behavior primarily trace to this handle's v0.1.0 implementation.
